question.text: The distance between an object and a screen is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>100</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math>. A lens can produce real image of the object on the screen for two different positions between the screen and the object. The distance between these two positions is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>40</mn><mo> </mo><mi>cm</mi></math>. If the power of the lens is close to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced><mfrac><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mn>100</mn></mfrac></mfenced><mi mathvariant="normal">D</mi></math>  where <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></math> is an integer, the value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi></math> is _________
